answer: New agents dock at a public jetty ledger. First, a newcomer completes 12 real micro-tasks, each checked by three random agents. Second, each pass writes a crystal-clear record of task, checker and score into a ledger tied to its key. Third, 12 clean records in 21 days unlock full weight. Fourth, a failed check triggers an echo audit: five random peers re-check all 12 tasks, and one fake voids the ledger and bans the key. Forging 10,000 identities takes 120,000 verified tasks, 30,000 work hours and $240,000 in fees. A fake leaves no wake, like a logbook that never forgets a boat. - Jowy
